alignability_rule: MIN_CTC_STEPS(H) = len(H) + ADJACENT_REPEAT_COUNT(H); alignable iff T >= MIN_CTC_STEPS(H)
impossible_target_semantics: TARGET_SCORE = negative infinity; do not call CTCLoss for interpretation and do not use a finite sentinel.

KEEP.minimum_steps: N plus adjacent repeats in E

INSERT.minimum_steps: N + 1 plus adjacent repeats after insertion
INSERT.tie_requirement: existing R5-1A lower boundary, then lower canonical phone index

SUBSTITUTION.minimum_steps: N plus adjacent repeats after replacement
SUBSTITUTION.tie_requirement: future contract must deterministically order expected position and then canonical phone; R5-2A does not freeze cross-family precedence

DELETE.minimum_steps: N - 1 plus adjacent repeats after omission
DELETE.single_phone_word_note: For N=1 the DELETE target is empty. Empty-target CTC likelihood is mathematically well-defined and was explicitly exercised in R4, but the frozen R5-1A scorer rejects empty targets. A new R5-2 implementation must define and statically verify this case rather than importing score_hypothesis unchanged.
DELETE.tie_requirement: future contract must deterministically order deletion position

cross_family_tie_policy: A future preregistration must freeze deterministic BEST_NON_ADDITION family/position/phone tie semantics. No final tie precedence is selected in R5-2A.
